usedFor: Shopify holds the orders, and Parma keeps the history through “Add Note to Contact” after an “Order Cancelled”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Add Note to Contact” in Parma
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation is worth remembering, so the note keeps it on the contact.

watchOut: “Add Note to Contact” needs a contact to attach to, so make sure “Order Cancelled” brings one.
